title.narrative: Integrated Development of Key Townships in Central Liaoning

description.narrative: The project aims to promote balanced and environmentally sustainable urbanization; narrow the rural-urban gap; and improve living conditions by supporting the development of five key townships in central Liaoning Province, People's Republic of China (PRC). The project will support urban water supply, wastewater management, energy efficient heat supply, and urban road and bridge construction and related services.

description.narrative: Improved sanitation, heating, and transport services in key townships in central Liaoning

(vii) Traffic fatality rates for every 10,000 vehicles decreased by 15% on average from 4.26 to 3.62 Progress/Status: To be assessed during completion review mission. Data Source: Statistics issued by Public Security Bureau Actual value:

(iv) District heating coverage increased in Fuxin from 18.9 to 21.9 million m2; Progress/Status: 300million m2 of newly added coverage. the indicator will be assessed during completion review mission. Data Source: PCC issued by the Fuxin HURCC Actual value:

(vi) Operational length of bus lines increased from 391 km to 563 km; Progress/Status: Construction of all road contracts have been completed. the indicator will be assessed during completion review mission. Data Source: PCC issued by the Liaoning HURCC Actual value:

(v) Road network density increased on average from 393.5 to 460.2 km of road per 100 km2 of land area Progress/Status: Construction of all road contracts have been completed. Xinmin: 49.64km Shenbei: 20km Heishan: 33.6km Gaizhou: 33.11km Huanren: 21km Benxi: 2.55km Data Source: PCC issued by the Liaoning HURCC Actual value:
